data_file.title: Email from Principal regarding Sports Day feedback
data_file.content:
Subject: Sports Day Feedback and Suggestions

Dear Students and Teachers,

Following the recent Sports Day, I would like to thank everyone for their participation and hard work. The event was a great success, and your enthusiasm was truly appreciated. 

To further improve future Sports Days, we are seeking feedback on various aspects of the event, including event selection, scheduling, volunteer roles, and facilities. Please submit your suggestions to the Student Council by next Friday. 

Sincerely,
Mr. Chan
Principal
